ACCESSIBILITY DECLARATION DEMO VIDEO
Prepared 2026-10-17.

CURRENT STATUS: LOCAL REMASTER EXPORTED. EN 85.83 seconds; UK 112.70 seconds. Full decoding, levels and caption timing passed. Chronological frames were inspected at 2.5-second intervals and at key transitions. Complete narration tracks received automated audio listening assessment; no human listening is claimed. Hosting, anonymous link access and Play submission are not completed. Google approval is not obtained.

FILES
Primary: video/accessibility-review-en.mp4 — English narration and synchronized captions.
Additional: video/accessibility-review-uk.mp4 — Ukrainian narration and synchronized captions.
Actual English phone UI in both. H.264 720x1680 30fps yuv420p; AAC mono 48kHz. OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, cedar, synthesis speed 1.04, one continuous take per language. Idle waits were edited; recorded gestures play at normal speed. No scene-dependent speech acceleration. AI narration is disclosed in the picture. Matching SRT files are included.
Measured integrated loudness: EN -16.53 LUFS, UK -16.58 LUFS. True peaks: EN -1.46 dBTP, UK -1.47 dBTP. No silent gap longer than 1.4s at -45dB. See video/video-quality-report.json for exact verification limits.

RECORDED CONTENT
Actual phone recordings show the app opening; the complete in-app AccessibilityService disclosure, decline, reopening and affirmative consent; Android Accessibility permission activation; ordinary YouTube playback; and YouTube Shorts blocking. Private PIN entry is excluded. Personal video content is masked and private feed transitions are omitted with explanatory captions. Other supported social apps are not demonstrated.

HOSTING RECOMMENDATION
Google prefers a YouTube link and also supports a Google Drive link to an MP4 or another common video format. For YouTube, Unlisted is a practical recommendation, not a claim that Google mandates that visibility mode for Accessibility declarations. Ensure that the reviewer can play the video without requesting access.

Suggested title:
Shorts Blocker Kids 1.0.0 - AccessibilityService review demo

Suggested description:
Review demonstration of the in-app Accessibility disclosure, refusal and consent flow, Android permission activation, ordinary YouTube playback, and YouTube Shorts protection in Shorts Blocker Kids. The app is a parent-facing digital wellbeing tool, not a disability support tool. This recording demonstrates YouTube; other supported app selections are not demonstrated here.

The owner must select truthful YouTube audience and account settings. Do not choose an audience designation automatically based only on the word Kids in the app name.

ACCESS CHECK — TO BE COMPLETED AFTER HOSTING
1. Copy the final video URL.
2. Open it in a signed-out/incognito browser.
3. Verify it plays without login, access requests, expiry or owner intervention and that the image and captions are readable.
4. Place the verified URL in the Accessibility declaration's video field. Keep it available during review.
5. Record the final URL and check date in the submission handoff. Do not leave a placeholder in the submitted form.

A store-listing preview video is a separate asset with its own Play requirements. Accessibility declaration hosting guidance does not establish eligibility for the store preview field.
